panels.alt: A mossy stone well with a hanging lantern beside a foggy village and river at dusk.
panels.caption: The chapel bell tolled thirteen times—and Oakhaven’s well water turned black as pitch.

panels.alt: Maren, the village archivist: a guarded middle-aged woman in a dark wool cloak, arms crossed.
panels.name: Maren — Archivist
panels.speech: No one touched the seal, traveler. The old forest curse woke on its own.
panels.hint: Mud at the well · broken abbey seal

panels.alt: A hidden stone stair winding down beneath the well, lit by a lantern.
panels.narration: You match the crimson wax to the archivist’s ring — revealing a hidden stair beneath the well.

panels.alt: A hidden stone stair winding down beneath the well, lit by a lantern.
panels.narration: She flinches, dropping a heavy iron key that unlocks the stair beneath the well.
